verdict.rationale: A public status page with historical incident postmortems is a fair thing to ask of a hosted serverless platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, an incident history, or postmortems. The 'built-in observability' claims cover monitoring of users' own Workers, which is an adjacent feature and not platform incident transparency.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can check a public status page with historical incident postmortems before committing
